services.name: Why we go fishing
services.desc: Go south on Tamiami Trail to first stop light and make a right turn on to Ringling Causeway. Go west on Ringling Causeway, across Sarasota bay to St. Armands Circle and make first right turn off circle, "789 North". blurb: Guests fish for a variety of saltwater species including spotted seatrout, redfish, flounder, snapper, and more in Sarasota Bay and nearby keys. The 23' center console Panga Marquesas boat fishes both shallow flats and offshore waters. The charter is family friendly and suitable for all experience levels, including beginners and children.
